name: Egyptian ox-drawn plowing
description: An Egyptian funerary model portrays cattle providing draught power for soil preparation.

places.note: Present-day country or region reference; ancient political boundaries are not implied.

date.label: ca. 1981–1885 BCE
date.basis: Museum dates the model to the early to middle 12th Dynasty, approximately this range.

events.statement: An Egyptian model depicts a worker guiding a plow drawn by a pair of oxen.
events.caveats: The funerary model is a representation of a practice; it does not directly date a particular field or the invention of animal traction.

evidence.supports: Museum dates the model and identifies an ox-drawn plow scene.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest episode established by the cited evidence for this precisely scoped record; not a claim of global origin.

caveats: The model and a museum inference about access to oxen do not establish the ownership or rental arrangement of every farmer.

research.note: Initial evidence-backed admission; classifications and historical interpretations await independent review. Independent review checked cited event dates, wording and, where marked, numerical measures; other facets retain their original status.
